key_audit_matters: Migration to a new Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system.
auditor.emphasis_or_uncertainty: Inability of the Company to reliably estimate and account for in the books its obligations under Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) as per the Environment Protection (End-of-Life Vehicles) Rules, 2025.

largest_items: Income tax cases pending or in appeal amounting to 149,868 million.
Customs duty cases pending before appellate authorities amounting to 6,918 million.
Service tax cases pending before appellate authorities amounting to 5,135 million.

flags.text: Auditor highlighted inability of the company to reliably estimate and account for Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) obligations.
Migration of key business applications to a new ERP system during the year introduced significant data migration and control risks.
